component.name: Erewhon font
component.summary: Font package derived from Heuristica and Utopia

description.p: Erewhon is based on the Heuristica package, which is based in turn on Utopia. Erewhon adds a number of new features — small caps in all styles rather than just regular, added figure styles (proportional, inferior, numerator, denominator) and superior letters. The size is 6% smaller than Heuristica, matching that of UtopiaStd.
